w2-checks.tmdbState: On, no key — enrichment inactive. Add a key below.
w2-checks.aiHeader: Only your question and a short list of candidate titles go to your provider — never your watch history, credentials or stream links, unless you switch sharing on below. Billed separately by your provider; a ChatGPT subscription does not cover API use.
w2-checks.resetDialogBody: This wipes all playlists, favorites, recents, watched progress, profiles, app settings and cached lists. A snapshot is saved just before the reset: Restore last backup brings back everything above except the TMDb key (never stored in a backup — re-enter it) and cached lists (they rebuild on the next refresh). Without that snapshot, the wipe is permanent.
w2-checks.backupHelper: Save playlists, favorites, recents, watched progress, hidden categories, followed series, profiles and app settings to a file. The TMDb key and the AI key are never included — keep them safe separately. Cache and the downloads queue are not exported.
